_comment: Sync ledger — OWNED BY the /linear-sync skill (planner.py), do not hand-edit. Maps this feature's milestones + ISSUES to company Linear objects, with a content hash per item so re-runs are idempotent (only changed items push). Sub-issues are PERSONAL and never appear here. company_linear_id is mirrored into each item's front-matter as the human-visible anchor. Issue/milestone status is the rolled-up value at last sync.
